en: A color illustration of a uniformed officer on horseback, viewed in profile, wearing a white tunic with gold epaulettes and decorations, dark riding boots, and blue trousers with red stripes. The horse is draped with a richly embroidered red and gold saddle blanket bearing an order-like insignia. Several similarly uniformed officers on horseback stand in the background against a hazy tree line. The image has the texture and wear typical of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible text is present on the front.
